alignments.note: The supplied subordinator “as” belongs to the participle's finite-clause rendering.
The article supplies the temporal nominal “day.”

Rule 73 keeps the support-verb construction ἐκβολὴν ἐποιοῦντο together: “throw … overboard” verbalizes the action noun, while “they began to” supplies the finite subject and inceptive imperfect frame, not a separate lexical rendering of ποιέω. Splitting that frame onto the support verb is conceivable, but does not establish independent ownership under rule 2; the inflection-licensed helpers stay with the collapsed pair. The unit is aligned because “throw” realizes ἐκβολή, which supplies the source head.
The projection has no source token for the ASV's supplied lexical object “the freight”; the jettison construction is already realized by “throw … overboard.”
